laws.rule: In Lima, street rules are set by each district. Miraflores' Ordinance 480 bans drinking liquor on the public road and inside vehicles parked on it, and its municipality has fined people for it with police. Other districts (for example Barranco, or those along the Costa Verde) have their own ordinances and were not checked.
laws.penalty_signal: 70% of one UIT (the annual tax unit), reported as 3,080 soles at the 2021 value of the UIT; the UIT is reset each year, so the current amount is higher and was not checked
